title: enrichVolcano
text: Related gene sets often reach significance together. GO:BP Reactome, one biological signal can light dozen overlapping terms. dedup() flags one per cluster "redundant", plots hide redundant terms default (collapse = TRUE). row removed p-value changes: multiple-testing correction already covered every term, redundancy display decision. Within contrast database, significant terms walked smallest padj. term redundant gene set similar enough term already kept: similarity = "combined" (default, cutoff 0.375) EnrichmentMap coefficient: mean Jaccard index overlap coefficient. overlap coefficient catches small set nested inside large one, Jaccard alone misses. similarity = "jaccard" (cutoff 0.5) shared genes genes either set. method = "collapse_pathways" different kind rule. calls fgsea::collapsePathways(), asks whether term still enriched genes significant term conditioned . new statistical test, needs ranking contrast tested , works ranked GSEA results, reported analysis. Call set.seed() first; permutes. published fgsea results carry flags computed upstream Jaccard rule. as_enrichment() keeps records object precomputed: Hallmark GO slim lose nothing built non-redundant. Deduplication matters large collections Reactome:
code: gene_sets <- split(msig$gene_symbol, msig$gs_name) x <- dedup(x, gene_sets) x <- dedup(x, gene_sets, similarity = "jaccard") x <- dedup(x, gene_sets, method = "collapse_pathways", stats = list(Aging = ranks)) table(ex@results$dedup_status, ex@results$database, useNA = "ifany") #>             #>             GO Slim GO:BP Hallmark KEGG Reactome #>   kept           34   173       22   20      292 #>   redundant       0    79        0   35      261 #>   <NA>           74  3694      122   29      735 reactome <- load_gene_sets("Reactome") set.seed(1) aging <- run_enrichment(yvo, reactome, tests = "fgsea")$fgsea #> Up to 10 of 2103 ranked genes tie; fgsea orders tied genes arbitrarily. aging <- dedup(aging, reactome$Reactome) volcano_ring(yvo$da, aging, contrast = "Aging", title = "Aging, Reactome")

title: enrichVolcano
text: nes_scatter() plots every term’s score one contrast score another. answers two kinds question, set comparison. examples draw published fgsea results, ex; res$fgsea works way. default, comparison = "concordance", asks whether two conditions regulate pathways. Terms shaded top-right bottom-left quadrants move way .  comparison = "reversal" asks whether one condition undoes another. unshaded quadrants hold answer: pathway raised aging lowered training, reverse. reference line becomes y=−xy = -x.  term counts significant contrast padj p_threshold (0.05); colour says whether holds one contrast . Pathways judged false discovery rate alone. Scores combine effect size p, π\pi-value, defined single proteins, gene sets. corner counts headline share use significant terms ; Spearman’s ρ\rho uses every plotted term, 95% interval correlation package installed. color_by shape_by take per-term column, example color_by = "database", databases, collapse label_min_size work ring.
code: nes_scatter(ex, "Training_Young", "Training_Old", databases = c("Hallmark", "GO Slim")) nes_scatter(ex, "Aging", "Training_Old",   comparison = "reversal", databases = c("Hallmark", "GO Slim") )

title: enrichVolcano
text: volcano_ring_theme() holds palette; plot arguments hold layout. arguments reach : magnitude: arc height encodes, "neg_log_padj" "size". arc_height_range: shortest tallest arc. arc_order: order arcs "padj" absolute score within half. x_scale, y_scale: compress volcano points crowd ring. label_mode, label_n, label_genes: proteins get text. show_counts, disc_color: count badges tinted central disc. volcano_ring_grid() draws one ring per contrast collects shared legend; extra arguments pass every ring.
code: volcano_ring(yvo$da, res$fgsea,   contrast = "Training_Young",   theme = volcano_ring_theme(palette = "okabe"),   label_mode = "top_per_direction", label_n = 4 ) g <- volcano_ring_grid(yvo$da, res$fgsea, contrasts = c("Training_Young", "Training_Old"), ncol = 2) g$plot

title: enrichVolcano 0.2.0
text: enrich_volcano() longer pins method = "jaccard" dedup default; hero function now inherits whatever default ev_collapse() ships, users calling wrapper defaults get documented "collapse_then_jaccard" behavior. ev_collapse_fgsea() now looks pathway gene sets (database, pathway) rather name alone. previous flatten preserved duplicate pathway names across databases, user combining (example) custom GMT MSigDB collection shared pathway name get first database’s gene set rows. ev_collapse_fgsea() now partitions input contrast runs fgsea::collapsePathways per contrast matching gene-level rank vector. Previously, scope = "global" multiple contrasts, every pathway silently scored first contrast’s ranks. ev_collapse(method = "jaccard_then_collapse") (deprecated "" alias) now passes Jaccard survivors collapse step writes back positionally, mirroring "collapse_then_jaccard". previous -merge drop members redundant cluster collapsePathways Jaccard’s keep_by tie-breaker disagreed row represented cluster. ev_enrich() ev_filter$n_pathways_after now structurally parallel n_pathways_before even every contrast empty (previously integer(0) instead named integer keyed database).
